subject: Short-notice: consolidate two demo blocks into single compressed session
messages:
From: Paula Chen <paula.chen@nimbuspay.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 08:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough — two sessions this week

Hey team — thanks again for the slot offers. Quick update from our side: two separate stakeholder groups (product ops + payments execs) both requested live demos this Thursday. I realize that's short notice, but we may need to compress into a single session so we don't lose the exec window.

Is there any chance you can combine the two sessions into one 45-minute walk-through that highlights the integration flow + exec summary? If not, can you recommend which content to prioritize? I can pull both attendee lists and send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the flexibility — we want to avoid asking execs to take two slots.

— Paula
NimbusPay

Attachments: attendee_lists_old.xlsx (we'll reconcile)
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Paula Chen <paula.chen@nimbuspay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, sales_ops@nimbuspay.com
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough — two sessions this week

Hi Paula — thanks for the heads up, and totally get the double-book risk. We can do a single, compressed 45-minute session this Thursday. Proposed plan: 

- 0–5m: quick exec summary (value, outcomes) — Olga (brief)
- 5–25m: live demo of integration flow and common failure modes — Marissa
- 25–40m: payments-specific deep dive (latency/cost examples, routing) — Connor
- 40–45m: next steps + Q&A and sync to follow-up materials

If you'd like, we can record the session and then follow up with a 15–20m breakout recording for the product ops group focused on admin flows. That way execs get the concise overview and ops can watch the recording on their own time.

Can you confirm stakeholders and whether execs need C-level focus (ROI / compliance) vs. technical assurance? I attached an updated agenda draft and a CSV where I started consolidating attendees. If you send the final list, I'll create a combined invite and propose three time options.

— Olga
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: nimbus-demo-agenda-v2.pdf, combined-attendee-list.csv

Paula — if the execs care most about compliance and uptime guarantees, call that out and I'll compress the examples to show SLAs and incident runbooks quickly.

— Marissa

1) Please share the final attendee list with role tags (exec / eng / ops) so we know how much detail to show.
2) Advance any integrator questions (SFTP vs. API, retention windows) in the invite so we can surface examples.

I'll be on the call.
